international.title: Heavy rain and snow predicted in California as ‘atmospheric river’ moves across state
international.summary: Flood advisories issued for much of Bay Area with coastal flooding and heavy surf possible in southern California Heavy rain or snowfall is predicted across California this week, as an “atmospheric river” dumps precipitation across the state. Flood advisories have been issued for much of the Bay Area , according to the National Weather Service (NWS), while southern California may see coastal flooding, heavy surf, wave damage to coastal piers and parking lots , and beach sand erosion.
